create_standardize_layer: create a Standardize layer that normalizes a named array across specified axes with a given epsilon
build_layer_norm: build a LayerNorm layer from config with named axes, epsilon, and dtype for standardization with learned scale and bias
create_rms_standardize: create an RMSStandardize layer that root-mean-square normalizes a named array across specified axes without learnable parameters
build_rms_layer_norm: build an RMSLayerNorm layer from config with named axes, epsilon, and dtype for RMS normalization with learned scale
test_standardize_call: test the Standardize layer __call__ method to verify it standardizes a named array across given axes
